study_role: fixed-size supplemental diagnostic with prespecified comparisons; no power adequacy claim; not new external validation

factorial.scope: controlled rescoring; not full original algorithm

primary_metric: post_settlement_brier on shared state after both O and S settle; not ten-round online ALC
secondary_metric: known-p expected Brier, family regret, proxy ranks, count, risk
multiplicity: global Holm two-sided paired t tests; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals
stopping: fixed counts; no interim significance looks, no seed additions based on outcome
bridge: raw real covariates; D-only median/standardization/clipping; no engineered groups or overwritten coordinates; artificial labels from declared logistic/nonlinear DGP
limitations: fixed real X reused across simulation seeds, conditional on those cohorts
mean t intervals use world-level normal approximation
family oracle is offline and conditional on realized training labels, not a deployable acquisition policy
component effects refer to fixed-family rescoring, not all effects of removing pending information
